## Fix Summary

### Bug
When a user toggles "Use Dark Theme" in Settings, the app restarts but **restarts the Settings screen itself** (via `getIntent()`), not the main GpsTestActivity. The user is returned to a freshly-opened Settings page with no explanation, which is confusing.

### Root Cause
In `Preferences.java`, the dark theme listener used `getIntent()` which returns the Intent that launched *Preferences* — not the main activity. With `FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK`, this clears the back stack and re-launches Settings instead of GpsTestActivity.

### Changes (2 files)

**1. `GPSTest/src/main/java/com/android/gpstest/Preferences.java`** — Lines 136–148

| Before | After |
|--------|-------|
| `final Intent intent = getIntent();` | `Intent intent = new Intent(Preferences.this, GpsTestActivity.class);` |
| No user notification | Added Toast: *"Theme updated. The app will restart to apply the new theme."* |

**2. `GPSTest/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`** — Line 205

Added string resource:
```xml
<string name="pref_theme_restart_message">Theme updated. The app will restart to apply the new theme.</string>
```
